rules.body:
Match two identical tiles with a clear path of at most 2 turns (see examples) to remove them and score points.

Clear all tiles before time runs out to reach the next stage. When no moves remain, the board shuffles automatically. You start with 10 shuffles and earn +1 per stage cleared. Top scores enter the leaderboard.

Left Click = Select
Right Click = Cancel
